description: The treatments and services EKO-IKSI and its two partner clinics offer, grouped by the sections of their price lists. Without `clinic`: an overview of all three clinics' sections and how many services each holds. With `clinic`: every service of that clinic by name. Use search_prices for the prices themselves.

clinic.description: One clinic, to list every service by name: eko-iksi (the main clinic), eko-iksi-ivf (partner clinic) or oilam (Oilam Medical Centre). Leave empty for an overview of all three.

language.description: Language of the answer: uz (Uzbek, the site's own language and the default), ru (Russian) or en (English).
